reading.zh: 本层阅读顺序：账号与会话 → 账号安全与风控 → 实名与未成年人保护 → 权限与角色 → 资料、等级与个人空间。箭头语义：call 同步调用、event 异步事件、dataflow 数据/投影流、reference 契约引用。
reading.en: Read in order: Accounts and Sessions → Account Security and Risk → Real-name and Minor Protection → Roles and Permissions → Profile, Level and Space. Arrow kinds: call, event, dataflow, reference.
